name: Camping 101: Tailoring
summary: A tailor can learn to make a Rallying Banner for a camp. Trianna in Darnassus teaches the pattern once you have shown skill in tailoring.

sections.title: A Banner for Camp
sections.body: Someone who values tailoring points you to Trianna in Darnassus. She can teach you to craft a Faction Banner for your camp once you have shown proficiency in tailoring. A banner can lift inspiration and morale on a battlefield, and the craft is within reach for a skilled tailor.

sections.title: Setting Up Camp
sections.body: With Trianna's teaching, you can craft a Rallying Banner. To try it out, find a place in the wilderness, since most folk dislike camps in the middle of town. Bring a campfire too; a cook can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who teaches tailoring a camp banner?
faq.answer: Trianna in Darnassus can teach you to craft a Faction Banner for your camp after you show proficiency in tailoring.

faq.q: What can a tailor make for a camp?
faq.answer: A skilled tailor can learn to craft a Rallying Banner for a camp.
An inspirational banner can help keep you energized, and inspiration and morale matter on a battlefield.

faq.q: Where can I test my camp setup?
faq.answer: The completion advice is to try the banner in the wilderness, since most folk dislike camps in the center of town.
A camp needs a campfire, and most cooks can teach you to make one.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can learn to craft a Rallying Banner for your camp after showing proficiency in your skill.
